name: Glamoured Studded Leather

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: +1 AC; a Bonus Action makes it look like ordinary clothing or another outfit.
text: Wearing this armor adds +1 to your Armor Class. As a Bonus Action, you can disguise it to look like ordinary clothes or a different sort of armor of your choosing. The illusion changes only its look, not its bulk or weight, and it holds until you either change it again or take the armor off.
